sloka: दृष्ट्वा विनाशितान् पुत्रान् बलम् च सुमहा यशाः ।स व्रीडः चिंतया आविष्टो विश्वामित्रो अभवत् तदा ॥१-५५-८॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vināśitān putrān balam ca sumahā yaśāḥ ।sa vrīḍaḥ ciṁtayā āviṣṭo viśvāmitro abhavat tadā ॥1-55-8॥

translations.english: Seeing his sons and army destroyed the illustrious Viswamitra was filled with shame and anxiety.
